definition: The era in the middling years of the Vallerii Empire where the Cherenkov radiation given off by their tachyon drive cores had rendered most of spacefaring civilization sterile, leading to the development of Xalians.

The Automated Protocol for Enforcement on Xalians. An artificial intelligence designed to regulate the use of Xalian Generators and prevent their use in warfare, who later turned on the Vallerii, beginning the End Wars.
A treaty spearheaded by ECHELON and signed by the Thousand Families, agreeing to place the Xalian Generators under the control of APEX in order to prevent their use in warfare.
The scientific name for the microorganism that produces Nightcap, a biochemical present only on Endessa that is necessary to induce stasis for sub-light space travel.
The final battle of the End Wars, in which APEX was repelled into dark space.
A factoryscape on Drainov which underwent a plant-wide melt down, setting of a chain reaction which led to the world-ending Drainov Disaster.
A form of radiation given off by Tachyon drive cores which rendered the spacefaring Vallerii population sterile, beginning the Age of Unbirth.
A Nightcap gathering plant on Endessa. The discovery of classified information at the plant led to the world-ending orbital bombardment of the planet.
A planet-wide chemical disaster site that was once the industrial powerhouse of the Vallerii Empire.
A chain reaction beginning at the Carbide-1 factoryscape on Drainov which vented world-ending levels of poisonous gas into the atmosphere in a planet-killing event.
A consortium of Vallerii corporations formed to present a united front against the aristocratic Thousand Families with the primary goal of ending the use of Xalian Generators in warfare.
An aquatic world known for being the sole source of Nightcap in the universe, which has since been reduced to a desert wasteland after a world-ending orbital bombardment campaign.
An inhospitable world of apocalyptic weather patterns which has since been terraformed into a a vibrant forest planet by the first Xalian Generator.
The first Xalian Generator, which was responsible for terraforming the planet Floria.
A planet of perpetual night on the outer rim of Xalia, which borders a black hole and is known for having been the last bastion of APEX's forces during the End Wars.
The most powerful dynasties of the Thousand Families who ruled the Vallerii Empire.
The original name of Endessa when it was still a vibrant aquatic breadbasket in the early days of the Vallerii Empire.

One of the last surviving members of the Vallerii race, who has used his knowledge of the Mercurius Machine to amass tyrannical power over the galaxy and institute the tournament for Scrambler Tokens.
A fiery hellscape of a planet known for containing valuable minerals.
A massacre of Xalian laborers that took part at a mining camp on Magmuth as part of a corporate power struggle which led to the planet-wide revolt of Magmuth's Xalian population against the Vallerii.
A unique device controlled by King Kozrak on Valleron, which prints Scrambler Tokens that can be used to breed new Xalians that are immune to the Nemesis Plague.
A galaxy-killing virus built by APEX which targets the genomes of the Vallerii and Xalians alike.
A biochemical present only on Endessa that is necessary to induce stasis for sub-light space travel.

A special chip printed by the Mecurius Machine which possesses a randomly generated and encrypted Xalian genome that can be used by a Xalian Generator to create new, unique Xalians that are immune to the Nemesis Plague.
A computer virus created by the Vallerii to wipe out APEX, which failed to kill to APEX but disconnected it from the Xalian Generators.
A colloquialism for Nightcap.
A criminal organization turned pseudo-corporate cartel on Endessa which exercises monopolistic control over Nightcap.
The only engine known to be able to achieve faster than light space travel, but which emits sterilizing Cherenkov radiation.
The war between APEX and the Vallerii, which resulted in the Nemesis Plague and the possible extinction of life in the galaxy.
The ruling families of the Vallerii Empire.
An ancient, hyper-capitalistic and imperialistic spacefaring race which created both Xalians and APEX.
The last bastion of the Vallerii race, where Vallerii scientists developed the Mercurius Machine over which King Kozrak has established his stronghold.
Massive, city-sized trees which keep Floria's weather in check and preserve life on the planet.
The galaxy in which Xalians live.

Bio-engineered organisms created by the Vallerii to serve as soldiers and laborers, who are specially adapted to the extreme environments of Xalia due to the incredible science of the Xalian Generators.
Sophisticated machines invented to generate new life on inhospitable worlds.

A warmwater paradise that served as a vacation destination for Vallerii high society until it was plunged into an arctic apocalypse caused by an asteroid impact and converted into a frozen prison world and planetary cold-storage faciltity for APEX.
A planet with binary stars that is subject to immense radiation, therfore serving as the solar energy capital of Xalia.
The largest agricorp in the Vallerii Empire, which was driven to bankruptcy in its attempt to terraform Luminax before the invention of the Xalian Generators.
A Dyson sphere which was constructed around one of Luminax's stars in order to capture over a hundred-quadrillion gigawatts per second of solar energy.

The 'Divine Light' solar cannon which was constructed as a superweapon from the Stellaris Superstructure. A system by which the panels of the Dyson sphere could be angled like a mirror to concentrate the solar energy of one of Luminax's stars into a deadly beam of energy.

A tomb world whose lifeforms are under constant assault from an unknown energy source emanating from its orbtial moon and whose Xalian Generator has responded by creating Xalians of a spectral, undead nature. Alternatively, the name of the extinct ancient alien species who once inhabited the planet and the top secret operation which uncovered their remains.

The original Vallerii name for the planet Phantiri, before the discovery the extinct alien species now known as the Phantiri after the name of the top secret operation under which they were discovered.
The star system which contained the ghost fleet that led to Operation Phantiri, the discovery of Shadharam IV, and the discovery of the extinct alien species now known as the Phantiri

The ruins of an ancient and colossal city belonging to the extinct Phantiri race, which was discovered on Shadharam IV as part of Operation Phantiri. Its uncovery triggered an eruption of energy from an unknown source on Phantiri's moon, extinguishing life on the planet and triggering the Phantiri Generator's propensity for the production of spectral, undead life.
An ocean world that is subject to toxic algae blooms, torrential hurricans, and immense tsunamies. The only known source of Algael in Xalia.
A biometeorological event that occurs on the planet Poseidas, in which supermassive toxic algae blooms in the planet's oceans saturate the air with poisonous microbes.
A blue-green, gel-like substance of sulfated polysaccharides formed from the decomposed algae found in Poseidas' oceans, which is known for its remarkable healing properties.
A hydrogen-helium gas giant that is home to the only known source of Benthane in Xalia.

A rarified gas found only on Saiphus that is used as a valuable heat sink for laser weapons. The gas is most commonly refined and processed into several derivative gases that serve as effective Tachyon Drive Core coolants necessary for contiguous lightspeed journeys.
Rogueish and rugged pilots who were once paid high sums to scour Saiphus for Benthane squalls.
Specially engineered Xalians designed to harvest Benthane from the skies of Saiphus, whose invention displaced the local Windsailor workforce.

A rocky planet with an incredibly thin atmosphere that is subjected to annual planetary bombardments as it passes through its star system's asteroid belt, leading to an immense saturation of valuable minerals and rare earth metals.
The star system that is home to Stonera, the Jorian Belt, and the now defunct APEX superweapon known as the Terracannon.
An asteroid belt in the Cybele System, which collides with the planet Stonera once a year. The home of the now defunct APEX superweapon known as the Terracannon.
A now defunct superweapon built by APEX which used a reverse-tractor beam to propel supermassive asteroids from the Jorian Belt at its targets.
A massive subsurface ocean on Stonera containing liquified metal and rich minerals, which was exposed when the Terracannon targeted the planet and blew away a quarter of its landmass.

A psychedelic world at the center of Xalia used by the Vallerii as a planetary asylum and beleived to be the origin of all life in the galaxy. The planet disobeys the laws of physics and is believed to contain a sort of psychosphere or planetary consciousness that drives its inhabitants mad.

A metallic world filled with dilapidated drones and believed to be a superstructure or worldship leftover from a now extinct alien race, , which served as the lynchpin of Vallerii industry and technological advancement throughout galactic history.
A mountainous, storm-wracked world whose unique weather allows for the generation of immense sums of electrcitiy, plasma energy, and Quantum Entanglement Devices.
A weather phenomenon on Zolton in which superintensive lightning generates a low-yield nuclear fusion reaction, generating a fatal neturon burst that releases deadly radiation into the atomsphere.

A weather phenomenon on Zolton identifiable by the frequent occurence of dark-red lightning and crimson lightning sprites, whose quantum entangling effects can be carefully channeled into a Quantum Entanglement Device
Quantum Entanglement Device. A specially engineered computer chip exposed to a Bloodstorm on Zolton, which can be used to link communications equipment across the galaxy.
